selection_rationale: Best alignment with the programme’s reliability/safety focus (verifier+LLM integration addresses unresolved integration gap U2), strong venue relevance, clear paired design and feasibility evidence, and reviewer verdict=pass after addressable design repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: To what extent do LLM-based NetOps systems generalize across vendor CLIs, routing/switching protocols, and large/heterogeneous production topologies? (U1)
What are the best-practice integration patterns and empirical effectiveness when combining LLM generation with formal network verification tools in NetOps pipelines? (U2)
What operational safety and human-in-the-loop governance policies are necessary to make agentic LLM NetOps acceptable in production (metrics, latency, approval workflows, liability)? (U3)
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify concrete formal verifier(s) to be used (e.g., Batfish) and document known coverage/limitations; include an independent verifier or secondary validation for final-checks.

Define dataset sourcing, per-vendor/device-dialect quotas, and topology realism criteria; justify synthetic vs real examples and include production-like topologies or an explicit representativeness argument.
Pre-register exact formal property specifications (reachability/isolation/ACL rules), counterexample schema, and the verifier query set used for both intermediate feedback and final validation.
Define salvageability/exclusion rules for faults judged unsalvageable by automated repair and specify how these cases are handled in analysis (e.g., excluded vs counted as failures).

Detail the manual-annotation protocol for hallucinated-change labeling: sample size, sampling method, adjudication rubric, assessor qualifications, and inter-rater agreement target (e.g., Cohen’s kappa threshold).
